weapons.name: Arc Thrower
weapons.desc: Three crackling arcs. Strips shields and locks systems.

weapons.name: Glow Laser
weapons.desc: Lasers charged with Voltan light: each hit also adds a little ion.

augments.name: Voltan Halo
augments.desc: A ring of living light around the hull: a 4-point super shield at the start of every fight.

augments.name: Lightwell Cells
augments.desc: Shield layers recharge 12% faster and weapons 5% faster.

events.text: A Voltan light-temple glows at the beacon. The priests offer to bless your ship, for a donation to the lamps.

effect.text: A halo of light settles around your hull.
{who} glows so brightly the priests applaud. They insist you take a gift.

events.text: Voltan crews are singing to an ion storm, and the storm seems to be singing back.

effect.text: The storm leaves your ship alone, and the Voltans give you a gift of light.
